title: A Robust Bias Mitigation Procedure Based on the Stereotype Content Model

bias_targets.methodology: Using the Contextualised Embedding Association Test (CEAT) to measure the cosine similarity between contextualised word embeddings of African American versus European American names and Stereotype Content Model (SCM) attribute terms (relating to warmth and competence) as well as pleasantness terms.

Applying the Contextualised Embedding Association Test (CEAT) to calculate the combined effect size of associations between the contextualised embeddings of European American male names versus Mexican American female names and SCM/pleasantness attribute terms.
